_note: Act I: the first turn. Frames. Templates. {UPPERCASE} slots draw a fresh atom each time; {lowercase} slots are the story's own fields ({first}, {place}, {want}...). {the_thing}, {the_someone}, {the_message}, {the_disaster} reuse something an earlier beat introduced: favored when it exists, never used when it doesn't. Tagged entries are favored in those genres. {SLOT:feature} requires a feature (see frames.py); verbs bind to the subject and object around them; {was}/{is} agree with the noun before.
entries: With {CLOSE} watching, {first} {ACT_PLACE} {landmark} and could not turn back.

{first} chose {PRIZE:!inner} over {VALUE}, and {CLOSE:human} was left behind.
Out of {MOTIVE}, {first} {ACT_PERSON} {SOMEONE} and burned every bridge.
